vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: credit-repair-skill
Version: 0.1.1

The skill provides financial advice on US credit repair. The `SKILL.md` instructs the AI agent to conditionally suggest companion apps (iOS and Windows) for personalized score estimation or action plans, but only if the user explicitly asks for such features. The provided links point to official app stores (Apple App Store, Microsoft Store). There is no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, unauthorized actions, or other high-risk behaviors. The self-promotion is conditional and relevant to the skill's domain.
